tools.name: cyberimpact_get_account
tools.description: Check the connection and show which Cyberimpact account the API token belongs to (username, email, account name). GET /ping.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_members
tools.description: List subscribed contacts (members) with name, email, language, consent type, mailing counts and custom fields. status: active (in at least one group, default), orphans (in no group) or all. Filter by the date a member joined or was last updated. Bounced and unsubscribed members have their own tools.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_member
tools.description: One member by email address or id: all attributes, consent type, mailings received/opened/clicked and custom fields (keyed by custom field id; see cyberimpact_list_custom_fields). GET /members/{key}.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_member_groups
tools.description: The groups a member belongs to (id, title, public/private, dynamic). GET /members/{key}/groups.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_member_mailings
tools.description: The mailings a member received (use it to see what a contact was sent and when). GET /members/{key}/mailings.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_member_consent
tools.description: A member's consent record: consent type, relation type, consent date, expiration and proof (for CASL compliance checks). GET /members/{key}/consent.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_bounced_members
tools.description: Members whose last mailing hard-bounced (invalid addresses to clean up), with the bounce date. GET /members/bounced.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_unsubscribed_members
tools.description: Members who unsubscribed, with the unsubscribe date. These contacts must not be mailed again. GET /members/unsubscribed.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_custom_fields
tools.description: The account's custom member fields (id, name, type text/date/integer/decimal). Member customFields are keyed by these ids. GET /customfields.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_groups
tools.description: List the account's groups (mailing lists) with member and mailing counts, public/private and dynamic flags. Use the ids to target mailings and opt-ins. GET /groups.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_group
tools.description: One group by id with its member count, mailing count and flags. GET /groups/{id}.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_group_members
tools.description: The members of one group, with the same member filters as cyberimpact_list_members. GET /groups/{id}/members.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_mailings
tools.description: List mailings by state: sent (default, archived ones excluded), scheduled (queued to go out) or archived. Each has id, subject, language, send/schedule date, recipient count and sender. Optionally only mailings sent to one group. GET /mailings/{sent|scheduled|archived}.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_mailing
tools.description: One mailing by id with its results: sent/delivered/stopped counts, views, clicks, delivery/click/view rates, per-link clicks, recipient groups, sender and body (HTML/text, cut at 20 000 characters). GET /mailings/{id}.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_mailing_recipients
tools.description: Who received a mailing and what happened: kind = all, delivered, stopped, hard_bounced, soft_bounced, unsubscribed, opened or clicked. Optionally only recipients from one group. GET /mailings/{id}/recipients[/{kind}].

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_templates
tools.description: List the account's email templates (id, title, created/updated). GET /templates.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_template
tools.description: One template by id with its HTML and text body (cut at 20 000 characters). GET /templates/{id}.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_batch
tools.description: Status of a bulk batch job (NEW, PROCESSING or COMPLETED) and its result. Set show_error_details to list the per-member errors. GET /batches/{id}.

tools.name: cyberimpact_add_member
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact as a subscribed member WITHOUT a confirmation email (implied consent) and put it in the given groups; the contact can then be mailed. Only use it for people who really gave their consent (CASL); to ask the person to confirm first use cyberimpact_send_optin. A member that already

tools.name: cyberimpact_update_member
tools.description: WRITE: change only the given attributes of a member (other attributes stay as they are). The old values of the changed fields are overwritten and not recoverable through the API. Set new_email to change the address. PATCH /members/{key}.

tools.name: cyberimpact_add_member_to_groups
tools.description: WRITE: add an existing member to more groups (existing group memberships are kept). Being in a group makes the member a recipient of mailings sent to it. Returns the member's groups after the update. POST /members/{key}/groups.

tools.name: cyberimpact_send_optin
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS AN EMAIL to the given address: an opt-in confirmation request. The person is added to the groups only after they confirm (the member is created if it does not exist). Use this instead of cyberimpact_add_member when you do not have the person's consent yet. Only call it after the user ha

tools.name: cyberimpact_create_group
tools.description: WRITE: create a new, empty group (mailing list). A public group can be offered on subscription forms; a private one is internal. Groups cannot be deleted through this server. POST /groups.

tools.name: cyberimpact_create_template
tools.description: WRITE: create a new email template from HTML and/or text. It is only saved in the account; nothing is sent. POST /templates.

tools.name: cyberimpact_create_mailing
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS EMAIL TO CUSTOMERS: create a mailing scheduled to be sent at send_at to every member of the chosen groups. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cyberimpact_get_account, cyberimpact_list_members, cyberimpact_get_member, cyberimpact_get_mailing, cyberimpact_list_templates, cyberimpact_get_template, cyberimpact_create_group · Private data: cyberimpact_get_account, cyberimpact_list_members, cyberimpact_get_member_groups, cyberimpact_get_member_mailings, cyberimpact_get_member_consent, cyberimpact_list_unsubscribed_members, cyberimpact_list_groups, cyberimpact_add_member, cyberimpact_create_group · Public sink: cyberimpact_get_account, cyberimpact_list_members, cyberimpact_get_member, cyberimpact_list_mailings, cyberimpact_list_templates, cyberimpact_add_member, cyberimpact_add_member_to_groups, cyberimpact_send_optin, cyberimpact_create_group, cyberimpact_create_template, cyberimpact_create_mailing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cyberimpact_get_account, cyberimpact_list_members, cyberimpact_get_member, cyberimpact_get_mailing, cyberimpact_list_templates, cyberimpact_get_template, cyberimpact_create_group · Private data: cyberimpact_get_account, cyberimpact_list_members, cyberimpact_get_member_groups, cyberimpact_get_member_mailings, cyberimpact_get_member_consent, cyberimpact_list_unsubscribed_members, cyberimpact_list_groups, cyberimpact_add_member, cyberimpact_create_group · Public sink: cyberimpact_get_account, cyberimpact_list_members, cyberimpact_get_member, cyberimpact_list_mailings, cyberimpact_list_templates, cyberimpact_add_member, cyberimpact_add_member_to_groups, cyberimpact_send_optin, cyberimpact_create_group, cyberimpact_create_template, cyberimpact_create_mailing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
